name: Larkspur Storage
description: Storage specialist. Mid-range shop: fair market prices. We carry bookshelfs, tv stands, cabinets, wardrobes, shoe racks.
skill_description: We sell bookshelfs, tv stands, cabinets, wardrobes, shoe racks, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
